get-netlify-coding-context.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): returns public Netlify coding guidance and does not access account state.

netlify-deploy-services-reader.rationale: Pass-through (read): retrieves deploy metadata without changing deployment state.

netlify-deploy-services-updater.rationale: reviewed: deploys site content and can change the publicly served application

netlify-extension-services-reader.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): retrieves extension catalog and installation metadata without changing state.

netlify-extension-services-updater.rationale: reviewed: installs or removes extensions and initializes a database

netlify-project-services-reader.rationale: Pass-through (read): retrieves project and form metadata without changing project state.

netlify-project-services-updater.rationale: reviewed: includes access-control changes, secret environment-variable writes/deletes, form submission deletion, and project creation

netlify-team-services-reader.rationale: Pass-through (read): retrieves team metadata already available to the scoped Netlify OAuth token.

netlify-user-services-reader.rationale: Pass-through (read): retrieves user metadata already available to the scoped Netlify OAuth token.
